svg.title: B cell with clearly separated complete BCRs
svg.desc: Current B-cell body with seven single complete IgG-type BCR/CD79A/B units. Native molecular geometry preserved. TM centre y=151 is aligned with the cell outline; Fab, Fc and CD79 extracellular domains remain outside. Surface molecule count is illustrative.
